{{Quote|We have to find ways to coexist. To meet on common ground, like Father always taught.|Nadia Grell|<ref name="Nadia Odessen" />}}
'''Nadia Grell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sarkhai (species)/Legends|Sarkhai]] who became a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], later a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She also replaced her father, [[Tobas Grell]], after his death as the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]] until the outbreak of the [[war against Zakuul]].

When Nadia's former mentor, the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]], had mysteriously disappeared during the [[Eternal Empire]]'s conquest, she begin to search for the man that she loved, but Nadia later abandoned her search for her former mentor, dedicating all her efforts on the war against the Eternal Empire.

==Biography==
===Tomorrow never knows===
Nadia Grell was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[3664 BBY]]<ref name="Dates" /> to the [[Sarkhai (species)/Legends|Sarkhai]] couple [[Maykia Grell|Maykia]] and [[Tobas Grell]] on their remote [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]]<ref name="TORE" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Sarkhai">{{TORcite|type=codex|Sarkhai (Consular)}}</ref> During Maykia's pregnancy, Tobas gave up his dangerous career of [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeology]], and the [[Marriage/Legends|husband and wife]] expected their child to be the first of multiple children. When the young [[Parent/Legends|mother]] unexpectedly [[Death/Legends|died]] during childbirth, Tobas named their child Nadia according to Maykia's wishes and dedicated himself to being a loving father.<ref name="TORE" />

As she grew up in a warm home with the support of her father, who secured a prestigious position in Sarkhai's royal court despite his grief,<ref name="TORE" /> Nadia Grell was treated differently by other [[Youngling/Legends|children]].<ref name="Holonet">{{Holonet|companions|nadia-grell|Nadia Grell}}</ref> When Nadia was an infant, Tobas found her [[Telekinesis/Legends|lifting]] his collection of Sarkhai artifacts into the air without moving a [[Limb/Legends|finger]]. This revealed Nadia's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|powerful connection]] to the mystical energy field known as [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and her abilities grew stronger and less predictable. The rarity of Force-sensitivity among the Sarkhai, combined with the volatility of Nadia's [[Force power/Legends|talents]], drew suspicion and fear among other Sarkhai;<ref name="TORE" /> rumors spread of the girl having strange, mystic-like powers, and Nadia was shunned by her friends and silently feared by her people.<ref name="Holonet" />

Nevertheless, Tobas Grell selflessly defended his daughter and her talents,<ref name="TORE" /> shielding her while continuing to work for the leaders of their homeworld. Instead of lashing out, Nadia took the opportunity to learn about the intricacies of diplomacy and soon served as her father's personal assistant in trade negotiations.<ref name="Holonet" /> The government of Sarkhai appreciated Tobas' open-minded philosophy and insights as a [[Historian/Legends|historian]], appointing him to be Sarkhai's first [[Senator/Legends|representative]] to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] when the world finally joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TORE" /> Nadia was deeply curious about other [[Species/Legends|species]] and cultures, and she was eager to explore [[Realspace/Legends|space]] beyond Sarkhai alongside her father.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Sarkhai (Consular)}}</ref>

===She's leaving home===
Nadia was insistent on accompanying her father to experience the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]],<ref name="Holonet" /> and she began learning alien [[Language/Legends|languages]]. Indeed, Tobas indeed took his daughter off-world with him. He hoped to find someone to train her in the ways of the Force and reached out to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], who defended the Republic with their strength in the Force. However, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] considered Nadia too mature to become a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner and did not know what to make of her.<ref name="TORE" />

Less than a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] after Sarkhai joined the Republic,<ref name="Sarkhai" /> a [[Standard year/Legends|twenty-two-year-old]] Nadia Grell accompanied her father to meet with the [[Rift Alliance]]<ref name="TORE" /> in [[3642 BBY]].<ref name="Dates" /> Members of the Rift Alliance were key to the functioning of the Republic but were disillusioned with the Republic's leadership amidst its [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] standoff with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], which began in [[3653 BBY]] under unfavorable [[Treaty of Coruscant|ceasefire terms]] after the [[Great Galactic War|Imperial invasion]] started in [[3681 BBY]]. With Nadia as his [[Aide/Legends|diplomatic assistant]], Senator Tobas Grell wanted to build alliances with the Rift Alliance despite himself being loyal to the Republic and its [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] ideals.<ref name="TORE" />

Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]] invited the Rift Alliance for [[Rift Alliance campaign|talks]] aboard the famed [[Valor-class cruiser|Republic capital ship]] [[Fortitude (Valor-class)|''Fortitude'']]<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" /> in 3642 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> wishing to stymie the Alliance's threat of secession using the setting as a gesture of respect. The Chancellor also sent [[the Barsen'thor]]&mdash;a newly-elevated [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving as the Warden of the Jedi Order&mdash;as his delegate: that [[Jedi Consular]] was tasked with addressing the Rift Alliance's concerns to prove that their place was to be part of the Republic. As Alliance [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]], including Tobas and Nadia Grell, gathered aboard the ''Fortitude'' over the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Deralia]], the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was suddenly [[Attack on the Fortitude|attacked]].<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" />

{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}

===Helter-skelter Grells===
{{Dialogue|Tobas Grell|Nadia! Don't you ever&mdash;what were you thinking? He might have killed you!|Nadia Grell|I'm sorry, Father. I couldn't just hide while you were in danger!|Alauni|Charming. Really.|attr=The diplomats regather after the defeat of the Sith|src=<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" />}}
Nadia Grell witnessed the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] being boarded by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], whose leader, [[Arrax (Sith)|Arrax]], cut down crewmembers and ordered all senators onto the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command deck]]. Meanwhile, Grell hid herself in an air vent on the deck as the Sith tampered with the ''Fortitude''{{'s}} [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. Just then, the [[Barsen'thor]] and<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" /> his<ref name="Force and Destiny Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> companions arrived in the [[Deralia system/Legends|Deralia system]] with a [[The Barsen'thor's Defender-class light corvette|Jedi corvette]], and Grell contacted the Jedi via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] with a hushed voice. She relayed her experience and pleaded the Jedi to save her father, who was among the senators locked on the command deck. Before ending the call, she gave the Jedi the location of a [[Computer/Legends|console]] on one of the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] lower decks that could unlock the command deck.<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" />

While battling the Sith and their [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial troops]], the Barsen'thor realized that the ''Fortitude'' had been irrevocably programmed onto a collision course with Deralia. When the Jedi arrived at the command deck, Nadia drew a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] at Arrax to protect her father, who was lying on the ground. As Arrax taunted Nadia, the Jedi intervened by confronting the Sith. The Sith said he would fulfill [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Kyrus]]' command to kill all of the Rift Alliance's ambassadors, possibly with the exception of Nadia&mdash;Arrax mused that Kyrus "might find the girl an appealing prize of war" once she was incapacitated. Arrax then attacked the Jedi, who defeated him in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]].<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" />

Immediately afterward, Tobas Grell stood up and reprimanded Nadia for putting herself in danger by confronting the Sith, and she apologised before adding that she could not bear to do nothing while he was in danger. The other [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] then joined them, unharmed, including a characteristically sarcastic Senator [[Alauni]] of [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. Alongside the Barsen'thor, the group of seven spoke about the Sith's sabotage of the ''Fortitude'', with Tobas suggesting that they divert the cruiser's crash-landing into [[Aderalis|Deralia's lifeless moon]] before evacuating on the Barsen'thor's [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|corvette]]. When Nadia objected, the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] representative [[Shuuru]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] called her a "child" who should stop "babbling," but the Barsen'thor asked to listen to Nadia. She explained that crashing the cruiser into the moon would alter Deralia's tides and possibly flood entire [[City/Legends|cities]].<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" />

Nadia's alternative plan was to steer the ''Fortitude'' to a safe [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], which would require each of the survivors to coordinate with manually controlling the cruiser's engines: she would place herself in a leadership position to coordinate from the command deck, moving the team into action with her father's support. Ultimately, the group safely left the ''Fortitude'' and regathered aboard the Barsen'thor's ship.<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" /> While the Cold War ceasefire was becoming increasingly fragile across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]],<ref name="TORE" /> the Sith Empire absolved itself of responsibility over the attack at Deralia by claiming that it was carried out by "rogue elements,"<ref name="TOR:GNN">{{TORcite|type=message|SITH ATTACK AT DERALIA, REPUBLIC IN...|Galactic News Network: News Flash}}</ref>

===All together now===
{{Dialogue|Tobas Grell|A remarkable achievement. Balmorra couldn't ask for a better leader. Here, Jedi, I'll authorize Tai's request for Republic membership.|Nadia Grell|Hey, Tai, you'd better get started on an heir. Presidents have heirs, right?|Tai Cordan|You know, Nadia, I'm really going to miss you.|attr=The diplomats discuss Tai Cordan's new role as President of Balmorra|src=<ref name="Torch">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Passing the Torch|Balmorra}}</ref>}}
[[File:Nadia_Grell.png|thumb|left|200px|Nadia Grell aboard the Jedi ship]]
Alongside other members of the Rift Alliance from the ''Fortitude'', Nadia Grell sat in the upper deck conference room of the Barsen'thor's [[Light corvette/Legends|corvette]], which housed the Jedi Master's companions [[Qyzen Fess]] and [[Tharan Cedrax]] in the lower deck. The group of seven diplomats in the conference room introduced themselves, with Nadia adding that she and her father were invited to join the Rift Alliance almost as soon as they joined the Republic. They discussed [[Tai Cordan]] and his<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" /> [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> homeworld of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], a Republic ally with key [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Army/Legends|army]] [[Factory/Legends|factories]] under [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Imperial occupation]]; as trade secretary of the [[Balmorran resistance|Balmorran government-in-exile]], Cordan said that a liberated Balmorra would join the Republic. The Barsen'thor thus agreed to help Balmorra. Shuuru then said that the Rift Alliance could keep check on the new Jedi Master's progress while "stuck" on the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]], while Nadia expressed excitement "to see everything" from aboard the Jedi ship.<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" />

The ship docked at the Republic's [[Balmorra Orbital Station]] after jumping through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Working with the Balmorran resistance, the Barsen'thor overthrew [[Sith Governor]] [[Darth Lachris]] and had Tai Cordan installed as the new [[President/Legends|president]] on the planet. The Rift Alliance then met in the central chamber of the Jedi Master's corvette, with Tobas Grell authorizing President Cordan's request for Balmorra to join the Republic. Nadia playfully told Cordan he should perhaps start to make an heir, and the new president replied that he would miss her. Afterward, the group agreed that the Balmorran revolutionary [[Zenith]] would join the Barsen'thor's crew as liaison between Cordan, who would remain on Balmorra, and the Alliance.<ref name="Torch" />

===Attis Station===
====Scientists' garden====
With that settled, Tobas asked that he and his daughter speak privately with the Barsen'thor. Nadia revealed that she found an Imperial monitoring device beneath the corvette's [[Communications array/Legends|communications array]]. She had checked the Republic database to confirm this after the device self-deactivated when she picked it up. The woman suggested that while they were now safe, perhaps someone among them planted the device. Her father then raised another matter of concern: the Rift Alliance had lost contact with their [[Attis Station]] research facility on [[Quesh]], a planet<ref name="Torch" /> that was in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and contested between the Republic and Empire. Tobas confided that other members of the Rift Alliance did not want to share this information with the Jedi. They discussed the others' persistently skeptical attitude and agreed to investigate Attis Station, lest the Empire access its valuable research.<ref name="Torch" />

However, Nadia also pushed for herself to be on this [[Mission to Attis Station|mission]], despite her father's objections. While Quesh was dangerous, Nadia reasoned that because Attis Station was built with Sarkhai technology, she could get into the facility even if Imperials had taken over its defenses. She added that the Jedi would not need to protect her and should simply focus on saving the station's [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], and her father relented.<ref name="Torch" /> The Jedi ship then jumped through hyperspace and docked at the Republic's [[Quesh Orbital Station (Republic)|Quesh Orbital Station]], where all individuals were inoculated against Quesh's toxins before taking [[Fortitude-class assault shuttle|transport shuttles]] to the [[Republic Operational Headquarters]] on the planet itself.<ref name="Attis">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Attis Station|Quesh}}</ref> On Quesh, Nadia was unsure whether the atmosphere was safe to [[Atmosphere/Legends|inhale]] and thought that it made her [[Hair/Legends|hair]] curl.<ref name="Quesh companion dialogue">{{TORcite|type=location|Companion ambient dialogue on|Quesh}}</ref>

Nadia Grell joined the Barsen'thor and one of his companions at an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] entrance to Attis Station. It had been invaded by the Sith Empire, and Grell had to sneak around [[Imperial soldier]]s patrolling outside. She accessed the airlock's manual release. Grell said she hoped that those inside the station were alright given that, upon opening the airlock, the inside was "awfully quiet." The Sarkhai then ushered her two companions inside and closed the airlock to prevent contamination. She rejoined them after they freed some scientists and killed the Sith leader [[Kadon Vul]], and she asked the Barsen'thor to explain who the attackers were. Grell then walked to a nearby console, desperate to find survivors. She found live [[Security camera/Legends|security camera]] feeds showing researchers elsewhere in the building&mdash;and Sith heading toward them. As she became distressed at the thought of a repeat of the ''Fortitude'' attack, the trio were joined by Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="Attis" />

====Here comes the Force====
{{Quote|You have a talent for interrupting my work, Jedi. But you're not alone. That girl's here, too, yes? Fascinating. What's her name?|Lord Kyrus, speaking to the Barsen'thor via hologram|<ref name="Attis" />}}
[[File:Nadia Force.png|thumb|right|350px|Nadia Grell uses the Force against Imperial soldiers]]
Grell walked toward them, saying "I won't let it happen again. I won't!" She surged with the power of the Force and shoved the soldiers into the walls and onto the ground, stunned. Without looking back, Grell told her companions to take her override code from the console and protect the researchers, while she herself walked past the fallen troops and said she would distract them. Wishing that the Jedi would trust her as she trusted him, Grell opened the door behind the Imperials and ran away, leading them on a chase as they got back up to their feet. When the lead soldier called her a "girl" and threatened to put her on a dissecting table, she quipped that they would have to catch her first.<ref name="Attis" />

Upon rescuing the researchers, the Barsen'thor received a call via the room's [[Holotable/Legends|holotable]] from a Sith identifying himself as Lord Kyrus. He expressed curiosity at "that girl" accompanying the Jedi and asked for her name, which the Jedi refused to give. Kyrus followed up with taunts, claiming to know everything about the Jedi, including how his "servant" Arrax had been killed "to save the girl." After Kyrus' call ended and the Barsen'thor had spoken with the researchers to save one of their projects, Nadia Grell called the Jedi via his personal [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]].<ref name="Attis" />

Grell boasted that she was right in saying she would be fine and said she made a confirmatory check that the station was clear of further threats. She added that she was heading back to the Jedi's ship to allay her father's worry before ending the call. Later, Nadia told her father what happened on Quesh. Once the Barsen'thor was back aboard, Tobas spoke privately with the Jedi, thanking him for protecting Nadia and describing "Nadia's gifts" as being stronger than many Jedi, albeit unpredictable. Tobas believed that his daughter admired and was very fond of the Jedi, and the father asked the Jedi to be a mentor for Nadia.<ref name="Attis" />

===Their Majesties===
Afterward, the Barsen'thor's ship docked at the [[Hoth Orbital Station]] over the Outer Rim planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to defend [[Rift Alliance Coalition Forces]] against the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="The Coalition">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Coalition|Hoth}}</ref> In [[3641 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|2}} The final missions of Act II in the Jedi Consular storyline take place in close succession starting from [[Felix Iresso]]'s recruitment.</ref> following the recruitment of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Felix Iresso]] to the Barsen'thor's crew in his ship's central chamber, the Grells met privately with the Jedi there to discuss how the Empire was alerted to his [[Mission to Hoth (Barsen'thor)|mission]] on Hoth. Nadia's suspicion was that a traitor was among them aboard. She revealed she had been checking communications from the ship since she found the Imperial monitoring device and had found a message sent to the Empire when the channels were busy. Tobas added that this [[Spy/Legends|spy]] must have had communications experience. Although Nadia noted that Alauni could handle a dozen messages at once, her father asserted that Alauni only used her personal channel. As they discussed other members, Nadia recalled that representative [[Augin Blaesus]] was busy exchanging messages with the [[Erigorm Bureaucracy]] via the ship's communications array, especially during their time over Hoth.<ref name="Chasing the Legend">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Chasing the Legend|Hoth}}</ref>

Alarmed, Tobas told Nadia and the Jedi Master that he had sent Blaesus as an [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]] to meet [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sethun]] and Queen [[Nyscha]] of Sarkhai. Nadia's father said he had wanted to surprise her with the news that their [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchs]], wishing to mend relations between the Rift Alliance and Republic, were donating a [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] to the Republic. The trio resolved to protect the [[Sarkhai royal family|royals]] from Blaesus at their meeting place, [[Waypoint Station Three]]<ref name="Chasing the Legend" /> in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], with Nadia saying she would ask Tai Cordan to get his Balmorran [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to help in the interim.<ref name="Chasing the Legend" />

The Barsen'thor then [[Mission to Waypoint Station Three|piloted]] his ship to Waypoint Station Three, where he found the dead bodies of Sarkhai soldiers and civilians scattered across [[Lightfight|firefight]]-scarred corridors. He nevertheless also found the king and queen being held hostage by Blaesus and Lord Kyrus. The Jedi killed both of the Sith, but not before Blaesus gloated that he was among hundreds of "[[Children of the Emperor]]" who shared the power of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and were embedded across the Republic. The Sarkhai royals thanked the Jedi and hoped that the Grells were alright, feeling indebted to them and also granting the Republic access to Sarkhai's treasury.<ref name="Serve">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|To Serve the King|Waypoint Station Three}}</ref>

===Across the galaxy===
While the Republic provided transport for the royals to return to Sarkhai, the Barsen'thor returned to his ship. He and the Rift Alliance, including the Grells, spoke with Tai Cordan via hologram as the Balmorran leader informed them that his forces had routed a nearby [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]] but were subject to sabotage. They were then interrupted by a call from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council's]] Master [[Syo Bakarn]], who relayed the news that the Empire had started a new full-scale [[Galactic War]] against the Republic. The Barsen'thor also updated Master Bakarn on the mysterious threat posed by the Children of the Emperor. They discussed how the Rift Alliance still stood strong, and the members gathered resolved to follow the Barsen'thor's lead in finding allies to strike back against the Empire whilst the Republic and Jedi defended the worlds outside the Core.<ref name="Serve" />

The Barsen'thor consulted the [[Noetikon terminal|Noetikons]] of ancient Jedi knowledge on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and decided to [[Second mission to Hoth|pursue a lead]] on the ancient [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Rakatan Infinite Empire's]] "sleeping army" on Hoth. There, the Jedi took coordinates from a [[Rakata monument]] that pointed to a hidden army of [[Esh-kha]]. He gave them to the Rift Alliance to process aboard his corvette, and they reported that the location was [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], a high-security Republic [[Prison/Legends|prison]] planet in the Outer Rim.<ref name="Counterpoint">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Counterpoint|Tython}}</ref> Gathered in the corvette's central chamber when they exited hyperspace in the [[Belsavis system/Legends|Belsavis system]], the crew watched Nadia Grell speaking with Republic authorities via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]: their ship was being denied landing on Belsavis while Tobas' senatorial clearance was being confirmed. The father tried to calm his daughter down, saying that the authorities have the right to make their rules.<ref name="Hostile Population">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Hostile Population|Belsavis}}</ref>

As the Rift Alliance continued debating their approach to working with the authorities overseeing the [[Belsavis prison|prison]] directly above the frozen Esh-kha, Nadia Grell convinced the other end of the line to speak with the Barsen'thor. Assistant [[Komi]] appeared via hologram and hurriedly said that the authorities could not help the ship land due to an ongoing prison breakout. The Barsen'thor offered to help, which Komi gladly accepted on behalf of the prison's [[Warden/Legends|chief warden]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[S. Geland]], before the Rift Alliance docked their ship at Belsavis' [[Macula Station|Republic Orbital Station]].<ref name="Hostile Population" />

The Jedi Master [[Mission to Belsavis (Barsen'thor)|headed down]] to the planet surface, where he found that Commander Geland was also a Child of the Emperor.<ref name="Hostile Population" /> Aided by a Rakata named [[Lhunu]], the Jedi sought the influential Esh-kha leader named [[Hallow Voice]] as an [[Invasion of Belsavis|Imperial invasion]] released many Esh-kha&mdash;that were not followers of Hallow Voice&mdash;from stasis. Geland manipulated those Esh-kha to revolt against the Republic, adding to the general chaos of the Belsavis prison.<ref name="Asylum">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Taking on the Asylum|Belsavis}}</ref> Nevertheless, the Jedi successfully freed and recruited Hallow Voice, who had his army of followers freed on Belsavis. The Esh-kha was brought into the Jedi's ship's central chamber to meet the Rift Alliance, but Nadia Grell interrupted this meeting with an urgent message about her father.<ref name="Voice">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Voice From The Tomb|Belsavis}}</ref>

===Father===
{{Quote|No, it's okay! Father? Father, I can heal you. See? My powers can&hellip; can save you&hellip;|Nadia Grell|<ref name="Fearless">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Fearless|The ''Euphony''}}</ref>}}
Speaking via hologram, Republic [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sulle]] of [[Belsavis Orbital security]] reported to the crowd that Tobas Grell had been abducted following a meeting on the Republic's own [[Space station/Legends|orbital station]]. Sulle believed the senator to be lost due to sabotage of the station's systems, but Tharan Cedrax, an [[exo-technology]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] and member of the Barsen'thor's crew, said he would be able to analyze the trail of the abduction in ten [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]. Desperately hoping that her father would be alright, Nadia insisted on joining the Jedi Master to rescue him.<ref name="Voice" />

The Barsen'thor's ship [[Duel aboard the Euphony|intercepted]] the ''[[Euphony]]'', in the distant Outer Rim. Nadia Grell, armed with a green [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]], and the Jedi Master boarded the ''Euphony'' and destroyed its droid defences. This included four bipedal [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]&ndash;armed [[Guard droid/Legends|guard droids]], three [[Repulsorlift/Legends|hovering]] [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentry droids]], two tripedal heavy [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] with electrocution arms, and one elite pyromech of the [[Mark IV Guardian Droid]] model. Nadia and the Jedi found Tobas Grell being held in the ship's main cargo hold by a man who called himself "[[Stark]]." Although they urged Nadia's father to get up, the senator was unresponsive, having been [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] for information. Stark spoke about the Sith until he was interrupted by Nadia, who shouted at her father's tormentor, telling him to stop talking and that he did not deserve to live&mdash;she drew her lightsaber.<ref name="Fearless" />

Stark fought the two individuals before him in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. After felling the Imperial, Nadia brought her father down from his interrogation chair and tried to assure him that all was well. She tried to heal her father, refusing to believe that he was no longer alive. As the Barsen'thor confirmed that he was gone, Nadia wondered aloud if this was but a bad dream, or perchance a Jedi test. Stark made an unwelcome reply that "everything" was a test, which drew Nadia's anger again. She marched toward the Imperial and surged with the Force, which she used to blast him into the ground.

Scorning that "something like you" should not be outliving her father, Nadia re-ignited her lightsaber with the intent to kill the defenseless man before her. However, the Barsen'thor warned her against the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] temptation of betraying her ideals. Although the Sarkhai insisted that her people would turn against her family if she failed to exact "justice," thus rendering her father's work in the Senate worthless, the Jedi recalled that her father worked for peace and cooperation. As Nadia hesitated, Stark lost the Sith power that was sustaining him and died. The young woman realized that she had let her father's killer go, which she thought would "disgrace" her family in the view of her people, though the Jedi tried to reassure her. After apologizing to her father and asking him to "watch over us" because she still needed him, Nadia requested the Barsen'thor to help with lifting her father's body back to their ship.<ref name="Fearless" />

===Two of us===
The Jedi Council on Tython spoke with the Barsen'thor and his crew via their ship's central hologram. Master Bakarn offered the Jedi Order's condolences on Senator Tobas Grell's demise before [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] addressed Nadia personally, saying that her father had been a great ally and that the Council hoped she would continue her father's "noble efforts to guide your people into the Republic." The young Sarkhai affirmed that she shall do so, adding that her people would respect her as Tobas' successor. Master Bakarn then relayed a part of the late senator's will: given the threat of the Children of the Emperor, he requested that Nadia be trained as a Jedi Padawan learner by the Barsen'thor.<ref name="Fearless" />

Grand Master Shan told those present that the Council had discussed this and granted consent for Nadia to be trained as a Jedi. Nadia eagerly took her vows to the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]] and remarked that her father would be happy. Senator Alauni then chirped in that the Empire's audacious murder proved that something more than an Esh-kha army would be needed, and the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] representative [[Diab Duin]] proposed reaching out to the [[Voss Mystics|Mystics]] of [[Voss]],<ref name="Fearless" /> a planet in the Outer Rim.<ref name="TORE" /> The [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and people of its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city [[Voss-Ka]] reminded Nadia of her home.<ref name="Voss-Ka companion dialogue">{{TORcite|type=location|Companion ambient dialogue in [[Voss-Ka]]|Voss}}</ref>

At some point, Nadia Grell spoke with the Barsen'thor in her room in their ship's lower deck about her father's death. She was finding it very difficult, often thinking that her father would suddenly walk in say "Cheer up, Nadia. The [[Star/Legends|sun]] shines on a smile." She told the Jedi Master that she missed hearing that, even though she used to hate how her father would speak to her as if she was still a child. The Padawan concluded that she wanted to learn how to be composed like her [[Teacher/Legends|teacher]].<ref name="Being Composed">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|Being Composed}}</ref> Later, Nadia received a call on the ship from the royal family of Sarkhai and was designated their new representative, succeeding her father. Although she thought the royals deemed her father to be more superior than herself, Nadia was determined to earn their respect and told them her plans for the Sarkhai to learn from the Republic and especially the Jedi. Nadia later told this to the Barsen'thor.<ref name="New Responsibilities">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|New Responsibilities}}</ref>

===Here, there, and everywhere===
Nadia Grell continued her Padawan studies while balancing Sarkhai affairs. She studied the texts sent to her by the Jedi Council<ref name="First Lessons">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|First Lessons}}</ref> and reflected on her new experiences.<ref name="Peace">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|Dreaming of Peace}}</ref> She also befriended [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] Tharan Cedrax, who spoke about his hand-built [[Telescope/Legends|telescopes]] and interrupted her Jedi studies by offering lessons in [[Astronomer/Legends|astronomy]]. Nadia told her Master that Cedrax was charming and "curious about everything," which reminded her of her own father.<ref name="Charming Idea">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|Charming Idea}}</ref>

At some later point, she told her Master that she needed to take some time off from training to focus on Sarkhai affairs&mdash;a Sarkhai guild was asking her to petition the Senate for Republic assistance in building a new spaceport, but the guild was planning to build it over the Sarkhai's most ancient ruin, the [[Annex of Kespan]]. Nadia deemed it sacred, even though it was a collapsing site that could allow for faster construction compared to the surrounding forests, which would take [[Standard month/Legends|months]] to clear. The Padawan therefore asked her Master for advice; her intuition was not to let her feelings interfere with her people's need for trade.<ref name="Annex">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|The Fate of the Annex}}</ref>

Later, Grell updated the Barsen'thor that the disputing Sarkhai had listened to her, but despite her diplomatic achievement, she still felt lacking as a Jedi learner. She wanted to embark on a sojourn on Tython to learn about the ways of the Jedi, as the Barsen'thor had done as an apprentice himself. He encouraged Grell to do so, allowing her to use his [[Map/Legends|maps]] from his ship's computer. Aside from visiting Tython's [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]], Grell followed the trails of ancient Jedi and appreciated the world's peaceful wilderness. She also sensed a certain darkness that she thought must have been left by the first Jedi who broke with the Jedi Order. Grell concluded that Tython reminded her of Sarkhai and was a planet on which she felt her powers and Jedi teachings meet.<ref name="Beginning">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|Begin at the Beginning}}</ref>

===Corellia===
====Help!====
Around the start of [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Voss date">{{TOR_dates|Voss}}</ref> the Barsen'thor [[Mission to Voss (Barsen'thor)|helped]] the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] people, including [[Gaden-Ko]]. They travailed Voss' [[Cave/Legends|cavernous]] [[Dark Heart]],<ref name="Dark Heart">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Deep Cradle, Dark Heart|Voss}}</ref> which was akin to what Nadia Grell knew as "mouths of the hidden" in Sarkhai culture. In legends, such caves spoke with the voices of the dead.<ref name="Dark Heart companion dialogue">{{TORcite|type=location|Companion ambient dialogue in the [[Dark Heart]]|Voss}}</ref> After Gaden-Ko was ordained the latest Voss Mystic there, the Jedi recruited him to help the Republic. He again gathered the Rift Alliance in the central chamber of his ship, which had been docked at [[Voss Orbital Station]] over Voss-Ka. As they discussed Gaden-Vo's entourage of three [[Interpreter (Voss)|interpreters]], seven healers, and sixty [[Voss commandos|commandos]] and how the Republic's Ambassador to Voss, [[Sophia Farash]], was also a Child of the Emperor, Nadia Grell interrupted the meeting with a request from Syo Bakarn&mdash;the Jedi Master was hosting a [[Republic High Command/Legends|war council]] and wanted the Barsen'thor to join immediately.<ref name="Dark Heart" />

Master Bakarn and Chancellor Janarus spoke via hologram, greeting Gaden-Ko and Hallow Voice. Janarus requested that the assembled Rift Alliance stop an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that was en route to the Republic's Core World of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], tasking the Barsen'thor with capturing [[Capture of the Javelin|capturing]] the Empire's [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] [[Javelin (Harrower-class)|''Javelin'']].<ref name="Dark Heart" /> The Jedi's entire crew collaborated on the action as their ship, alongside the [[Rift Alliance fleet]], intercepted the ''Javelin'' in the Core. Nadia Grell accompanied her Master to infiltrate the [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnought]] via its weapons deck.<ref name="Shattering">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Shattering|The ''Javelin''}}</ref>

The Jedi Padawan and Master defeated dozens of Imperial personnel while their allies disarmed the ''Javelin''{{'s}} unusually light security. When they reached its bridge, they were told by a [[LI-45|droid]] that [[Detonite charge/Legends|detonite charges]] had been placed throughout the ''Javelin''. Grell resolved to send everyone the locations of these explosives, and she and the Barsen'thor disarmed those nearby while battling dozens more Imperial soldiers and battle droids of various sizes. After they had dismantled three charges across the command, engineering, and weapons decks, Qyzen Fess told them via the Jedi Master's personal holoprojector that more explosives had been found and requested that they flee the doomed dreadnought. As they did so, Felix Iresso insisted on retrieving potential battle plans from Imperial tactical stations, and he planned to use the ''Javelin''{{'s}} [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]].<ref name="Shattering" />

====Lt. Iresso's secret file group plan====
As Iresso signed off from the Barsen'thor's holoprojector, an explosion knocked the Jedi Master and his apprentice to the ground. They nevertheless continued escaping from the ''Javelin'' back to their corvette, where the Rift Alliance resolved to find Iresso on Corellia.<ref name="Shattering" /> The Jedi corvette landed at a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] at the [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]], which was part of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic-fortified]] [[Blastfield Shipyards]] in the Corellian capital of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. After recovering Iresso, the Rift Alliance discovered a file revealing that the leader of the Children of the Emperor, the First Son, existed within Master Syo Bakarn and had taken control of his body. The Barsen'thor discussed the issue with the Jedi Council. They planned for the Rift Alliance to retake [[Guardian Holds|key buildings]] in Coronet City from the First Son's secret Imperial agents, whom the Jedi would uncover and use to find the First Son.<ref name="Descent">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Descent|Corellia}}</ref>

In [[Guardian Hold Four]] at the city's [[Axial Park]], the Barsen'thor defeated a [[Daresha|Child of the Emperor]] and took [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grann (commander)|Grann]] and General [[Merion]] prisoner, with Rift Alliance forces securing the Hold. The Rift Alliance leadership and the Jedi Master's other companions, among them Nadia Grell, gathered at the Hold to negotiate with the Imperial generals.<ref name="Old Blood">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Old Blood|Corellia}}</ref> Given that her father said they would visit Corellia together someday, Nadia Grell was almost glad that her father did not see Corellia in its war-torn state.<ref name="Corellia spaceport companion dialogue">{{TORcite|type=location|Companion ambient dialogue in [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]]|Corellia}}</ref> She had only seen Axial Park in holos and did not expect its smell.<ref name="Axial Park companion dialogue">{{TORcite|type=location|Companion ambient dialogue in [[Axial Park]]|Corellia}}</ref>

====Jedi saw him standing there====
After General Grann indicated that the First Son was in [[Guardian Hold One]] at the [[Governmental Sector|Government District's]] [[Capitol Square]],<ref name="Old Blood" /> the Jedi left his meeting to break through the defenses of that bunker. Instead of finding the First Son there, he found members of the [[Corellian Council]]&mdash;[[Saiak|one of whom]] was a Child of the Emperor.<ref name="As Above, So Below">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|As Above, So Below|Corellia}}</ref>

After that Sith puppet was slain, the Rift Alliance leaders and the Barsen'thor's other companions, including Grell, met in the Hold alongside Secretary [[Nadien]] of the Corellian Council. Nadien was shocked that one of his colleagues was a Sith puppet and said that the First Son had moved to the tunnels underground. With the Alliance deciding to defend Guardian Hole One, the Barsen'thor headed down to confront the First Son, but not before telling his companions that no matter what would happen, it had been his privilege to meet every one of them.<ref name="As Above, So Below" />

The Barsen'thor defeated the First Son and helped Syo Bakarn regain control of himself, beginning to contain the Emperor's dark agent inside him and forever unmasking all the other Children of the Emperor at once. The Barsen'thor then reunited with his allies aboard his corvette as they spoke with the Jedi Council.<ref name="As Above, So Below" />

====It won't be long====
Before<ref name="As Above, So Below" /> the Republic achieved victory on Corellia in short order<ref name="Right to Arms">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Right to Arms|Corellia}}</ref> in 3640 BBY,<ref name="TOR 4">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> Grand Master Satele Shan asked the Barsen'thor to meet with the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor election, 3640 BBY|newly elected Supreme Chancellor]] on the galactic capital world of Coruscant.<ref name="As Above, So Below" /> The Jedi's corvette landed at a hangar at the [[Coruscant Spaceport]] on the planet.<ref name="Chaos and Harmony">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Chaos and Harmony|Coruscant}}</ref>

Chancellor [[Leontyne Saresh]] presented the Barsen'thor alongside the Rift Alliance leadership and the Jedi Master's other companions, including Nadia Grell, at a reception in the nearby [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. Saresh announced rewards for the Rift Alliance's member worlds, such as rebuilding and defence funds, as well as for Hollow Voice's Esh-kha and Gaden-Ko's Voss. Grand Master Shan also invited the Barsen'thor to take Syo Bakarn's seat on the Jedi Council, which he accepted before making a short speech to the attendees about resisting evil with the spirit of cooperation.<ref name="Chaos and Harmony" />

{{Endgame}}

===Adventure on Rishi===
At a later point during the Galactic War, Nadia was reciting the Jedi Code with her Master when Lieutenant Felix Iresso interrupted, explaining that their ship's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] had been [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]], its destination plotted towards [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Zenith chimed in that Rishi was a haven for pirates and gunrunners, so there was no way anyone from there could've done so. As the crew checked the navicomputer, Nadia's Master had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] that compelled the Barsen'thor to announce that they were going to Rishi.

===War against Zakuul===
The Barsen'thor disappeared when the [[Eternal Empire]] [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquered]] the galaxy, striking from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to overpower both the Republic and the Sith Empire. Although Tython had been [[Assault on Tython|attacked]], the Jedi Order moved the Noetikons to Coruscant, where Nadia Grell consulted them. She spoke with the [[Noetikon of Secrets|Noetikon]] of [[Bastila Shan]] in particular, and she decided to rally the Barsen'thor's old friends&mdash;the Esh-kha, Gaden-Ko, and the Balmorran resistance.<ref name="KOTFE Mail">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=message|I will find you|Nadia Grell}}</ref>

[[File:Nadia_Grell_on_Ossus.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Nadia Grell on Ossus]]
During this time, she also was promoted to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and at her request, replaced as senator by [[Thariki]], so that she could better serve the war effort.<ref name="Nadia Odessen" /> At some point before the return of the [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]], she met Jedi Master [[Gnost-Dural]] and joined in his efforts to establish a hidden Jedi colony on Ossus.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

===Forests of Sarkhai===
The Barsen'thor died while Nadia Grell still lived. After the Master who taught her had become one with the Force, Grell took [[Third Barsen'thor's holocron|his holocron]],<ref name="Force and Destiny Rulebook" /> which he had assembled on Rishi,<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=class|Jedi Consular|Barsen'thor's Legacy|Rishi}}</ref> and buried it in the forests of her homeworld.<ref name="Force and Destiny Rulebook" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Nadia_Grell_Ossus.png|thumb|left|200px|Jedi Knight Nadia Grell]]
As everything from space stations to alien species and languages were new to her, the twenty-two-year-old Nadia Grell lived with<ref name="TORE" /> wide-eyed enthusiasm, eternally curious<ref name="Holonet" /> about the galaxy beyond her homeworld, where she was shunned for her connection to the Force. However, she also worried about being stigmatized again, should her emotions trigger her volatile and overwhelming Force abilities.<ref name="TORE" /> Nadia was fond and protective of her father, Tobas,<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" /> who made a loving home for her daughter despite the tragedy of losing Maykia when she gave birth to Nadia.<ref name="TORE" /> The daughter ably gave the Barsen'thor pointers for saving her father during the attack on the ''Fortitude'', and she bravely took a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to confront the Sith threatening her father on her own.<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" />

Like other Sarkhai, Nadia Grell had pale white skin that she adorned with dark [[Color/Legends|blue]] face-paint. The pattern she wore was an old design called "to see faithfully."<ref name="Sarkhai" /> She also sported short white bob hair and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" /> Aside from her endless curiosity to learn about everything and test her own powers, Grell was a charitable woman who disliked cruelty and insulting authority.<ref name="Holonet" /> Despite having just endured the Sith attack on the ''Fortitude'' and been dismissed by some of her fellow survivors, she made a plan to try steering the cruiser away from crashing into the planet Deralia and placed herself in a leadership position, guiding each person from the command deck. She put forward her plan with humor too, remarking that "even I can miss a planet."<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Um. You know that stone I've been practicing my levitation on? I sort of&hellip; exploded it.|Nadia Grell, to the Barsen'thor|<ref name="BAC">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Balance and Control|the ''Defender''-class corvette}}</ref>}}
Nadia Grell's Force powers were volatile and difficult for her to control; prior to Jedi training and even as a Padawan, her power would occasionally surge beyond her grasp; she once destroyed a rock that she was levitating.<ref name="BAC" />

Nadia Grell worked with her father Tobas as his personal assistant, fulfilling diplomatic and [[Secretary/Legends|secretarial]] duties. As Nadia ventured beyond Sarkhai, she began learning languages.<ref name="TORE" /> She spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] fluently. Among the Rift Alliance members she worked with were the Selkath Shuuru and the Sullustan Diab Duin, who spoke in their own [[Selkath (language)|respective]] [[Sullustese/Legends|languages]].<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" />

==Equipment==
As a Jedi, Nadia Grell wielded a double-bladed lightsaber with yellow blades and a [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] that had a dark grey body with light grey and blue features in the middle, capped on either end with golden [[Emitter matrix/Legends|emitters]].<ref name="Holonet" /> Grell traveled the galaxy with the Barsen'thor aboard<ref name="BAC" /> his<ref name="Force and Destiny Rulebook" /> ''Defender''-class light corvette, which contained multiple rooms.<ref name="TORE" /> Grell had a spacious [[Sleeper (furniture)|bedchamber]] in the ship's lower deck.<ref name="Being Composed" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Overview===
{{Quote|All seasons, all worlds. Under stars, and earth.''"<br />"''You, and I...|Nadia Grell and the Consular reaffirm their relationship after Ossus|<ref name="Nadia Odessen" />}}
Nadia Grell is a major character in the Jedi Consular class storyline of the [[2011]] [[video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in which she is voiced by [[Holly Fields]].<ref name="Darth Hater Comic-Con 2011">{{WebCite|url=http://www.darthhater.com/articles/swtor-news/16386-sdcc-2011-day-1-live-blog-coverage/page-2|text=SDCC 2011: Day 1 Live Blog & Coverage|date=2011-07-21|author=Darth Hater|archivedate=20120118091725|nolive=1}}</ref> Throughout the Jedi Consular storyline in ''The Old Republic'', the player may choose dialogue options ranging from being protective and supportive of Nadia Grell to being dismissive of her. This article only [[Forum:CT:TOR and video game canon|assumes]] that the player makes light side options and does not assume specific dialogue choices otherwise. The various options, along with their different outcomes, are detailed below.

After first meeting Nadia Grell during the mission on the ''Fortitude'', the player has the choice of either ignoring her advice and crashing the ship while the Rift Alliance evacuate to the Jedi ship or heeding her advice and restoring the ship to a safe orbit before the Rift Alliance reolocate to the Jedi ship.<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" />

===Companion options===
====Character conversations====
After Nadia Grell becomes the player's Padawan in between the Belsavis and Voss storylines, she joins the list of companions from which the player could summon to accompany them on other missions. In companion character conversations, there are options for the player to enter into a romance with Nadia Grell if the player is male.<ref name="Charming Idea" /><!-- Balance and Control-->

====Voss====
=====Companion ambient dialogue=====
{{Quote|The trees, the people&hellip; Voss-Ka's so much like home. How long can we stay?|Nadia Grell, if she is the player's companion at Voss-Ka|<ref name="Voss-Ka companion dialogue" />}}
At the [[Shrine of Healing]], Nadia Grell's companion ambient dialogue is to comment that the Shrine seems much older than anything in the capital Voss-Ka and to ask the Jedi Consular if they thought it was always a shrine.<ref name="Shrine companion dialogue">{{TORcite|type=location|Companion ambient dialogue at the [[Shrine of Healing]]|Voss}}</ref> She also has two lines of ambient dialogue at Voss-Ka itself and one at the Dark Heart, comparing them to similar memories of Sarkhai.<ref name="Voss-Ka companion dialogue" /><ref name="Dark Heart companion dialogue" /> At the [[Gormak cannon]], she would comment that the making of the weapon was a waste of resources, time, and skill.<ref name="Gormak camp companion dialogue">{{TORcite|type=location|Companion ambient dialogue at the [[Gormak camp]]|Voss}}</ref>

=====Healing Gaden-Ko=====
During the mission to [[Voss healing ritual|heal]] Gaden-Ko on Voss, if the player has any companion, then the healer [[Orin-Va]]'s assistant [[Asha-Mu]] would comment that this friend is worthy, as with the Jedi, to help Gaden-Ko. If this friend is Grell, then she would either ask the Barsen'thor to let her take the risky task of healing or simply say that they must help, depending on the gameplay mechanics of how much "influence" the player has with Grell. If the former, then the player may take the light side option of volunteering themself instead, in which case Grell says she would interrupt if "anything funny happens," the neutral option of telling Grell that she should not risk herself, in which case Grell insists she could do anything with the Jedi's support, or the dark side option of letting her do it, in which case Grell is glad to follow through.<ref name="Marked">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Marked|Voss}}</ref>

If Grell simply says that they must help, then the player may choose the light side option of volunteering themself, asking Grell to do it, or asking Asha-Mu to do it. If the player asks Grell to do it, then she may either respond dismissively toward the player for not even trying to help the Voss or accept the request while saying that she was not scared. If the player asks Asha-Mu to do it, the Voss says she is unworthy of the "honor," to which the player could either volunteer via the light side option by saying "I will do what you refuse to"&mdash;which Grell approves&mdash;or taking the dark side options of insisting that the Voss do it herself&mdash;which Grell disapproves.<ref name="Marked" />

If Grell is conducting the ritual, then she would be struggling and nearly collapse to the ground. The player may choose to advise her to let the Force flow through her, which would make Grell feel better, to tell her to be strong, which would likewise encourage her, or to remind her that Jedi much younger than her endure much worse trials, which Grell would resent while apologizing for "disappointing" her Master. If the player has high "influence" with the companion character, then they may have the other options of telling Grell to stop or ask if she is alright, in which case she would insist on continuing the task. In all cases, Grell would successfully heal Gaden-Ko.<ref name="Marked" />

=====The Dark Heart=====
Nadia Grell reacts differently depending on the player's choice if she is accompanying the player while speaking with Gaden-Ko's grandfather [[Dajan-Ko]] in the Dark Heart. The player may ask Dajan-Ko either about the "First Son" that the Children of the Emperor have spoken of, about how the Republic could win the war against the Empire, or about pursuing power on Voss. Although Grell particularly approves of the foremost question, the first two are both light side options, and in both cases, Dajan-Ko gives ambiguous answers to which Grell exclaims "Wait, you can't just leave it at that!" The latter one is a dark side option that Grell disapproves of.<ref name="Dark Heart" />

When the Voss apprehend Sophia Farash at the airlock to the Barsen'thor's ship at the Voss Orbital Station, the Jedi's companion could have been Nadia Grell. If so, and the Jedi does not choose the dark side option of requesting that Farash be thrown into the Dark Heart of Voss, then Grell would tell the Voss Commander [[Jenar-Sei]] he could not let Farash get away when he says that Farash must leave Voss-Ka. Regardless of dialogue options or companion chosen, the Barsen'thor is forced to accept Jenar-Sei's clarification that Farash would be [[Step of Harmony|pushed off a cliff]] per Voss law. However, Grell would approve of the Jedi taking the light side option of telling Jenar-Sei that this punishment is "barbaric."<ref name="Dark Heart" />

This article assumes that the Barsen'thor made the light side choices to heal Gaden-Ko, ask Dajan-Ko about the fight against the Empire, and leave Sophia Farash to Voss authorities before successfully recruiting Gaden-Ko to aid the Republic without assuming which companion(s) accompanied the Jedi on Voss.

====Corellia====
During the mission on the ''Javelin'', the player's companion is set according to gender, with male Consulars being accompanied by Nadia Grell while female Consulars being accompanied by Felix Iresso instead. The other companion would then stay behind on the ''Javelin'' and need to be rescued on Corellia later.<ref name="Shattering" /> As the [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]] states that the Barsen'thor was male,<ref name="Force and Destiny Rulebook" /> this article assumes that Grell accompanied him on the ''Javelin'' and that Iresso was left aboard the ''Javelin''.

Nadia Grell's companion ambient dialogue at the Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport mentions that her father said they would visit Corellia together, with Nadia adding that she was "almost glad" her father was not looking at the world in its war-torn state.<ref name="Corellia spaceport companion dialogue" /> In the decimated [[Labor Valley]], Grell would ask how the Empire could simply go on murdering people in their own homes.<ref name="Labor Valley companion dialogue">{{TORcite|type=location|Companion ambient dialogue in [[Labor Valley]]|Corellia}}</ref> She would also comment on the smell of the bombarded Axial Park whilst there<ref name="Axial Park companion dialogue" /> and the size of Republic buildings whilst beside the [[Legislature Building|Corellian Legislature]] in the Government District, adding that the Sarkhai's royal palace was less than half its size.<ref name="Corellian Legislature companion dialogue">{{TORcite|type=location|Companion ambient dialogue at the [[Legislature Building|Corellian Legislature]]|Corellia}}</ref>

====Ilum====
{{Quote|Imagine training here. Going through that arch every day and looking up at the stars.|Nadia Grell, at Ilum's Jedi Temple|<ref name="Ilum temple companion dialogue">{{TORcite|type=location|Companion ambient dialogue at the [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)|Jedi Temple]]|Ilum}}</ref>}}
The world of Ilum in ''The Old Republic'' is set after the class storylines, during the [[Battle of Ilum]] toward the end of 3640 BBY.<ref name="TOR 4" /> If Nadia Grell is accompanying a Jedi Consular player at the [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)|Jedi Temple]] on Ilum to defeat Sith forces led by the [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Arho]],<ref name="TJT">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Jedi Temple|Ilum}}</ref> then she would remark to the Barsen'thor about the [[Water/Legends|ice]] arch over the temple's entrance. She imagined that being a Jedi learner there would mean that going through the arch would be a day-to-day occurence, coupled with looking up at the starry sky at [[Local day/Legends|night]].<ref name="Ilum temple companion dialogue" /> Jedi Consular Padawans at the time commonly studied the text ''[[The Unending Stars: Meditations on an Ilum Pilgrimage]]''.<ref name="TORE" />

====Makeb====
{{Quote|All these weapons and they still can't stop us. I'm sure there's a proverb in there somewhere.|Nadia Grell|<ref name="Consulting the Expert">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Consulting the Expert|Makeb}}</ref>}}
The world of [[Makeb]], introduced in the [[2013]] expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', is set in [[3638 BBY]].<ref name="Hutt date">{{TOR_updates|2.0}}</ref> If Nadia Grell is accompanying a Jedi Consular player at [[Keylander Station]] over Makeb, then she would remark that it is known as the "Gateway to Makeb" and known for having expensive souvenirs.<ref name="Trouble in Paradise">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Trouble in Paradise|Keylander Station}}</ref>

If she was joining the Jedi Consular during the Republic mission to meet with the Makeb leader [[Shalim Avesta]] at his [[Avesta Plantation|plantation]], Nadia Grell would remark with surprise the beautiful view that Avesta would wake up to every day. Joining her Master at the [[Frinn Mesa]] outside, Grell would say that she understood why Makeb attracted many tourists in the past, before war "touches everything," with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] [[InterStellar Regulators|Interstellar Regulator]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] being "everywhere" following the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[conquest of Makeb]]. Indeed, upon being ambushed, Grell would alert her Master to the hostile mercenaries behind them.<ref name="Shelter from the Storm">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Shelter from the Storm|Makeb}}</ref> Grell thought that the Hutts did not deserve the impressiveness of Makeb and would tell her Master at the capital, [[Talaos City]], that the Sarkhai could never build cities like that on their homeworld. She was concerned that one groundquake could create a giant trench in the city and wanted to hurry along with the Republic's plan to save Makeb, which was being destabilized by the Hutts' drilling.<ref name="Failsafe">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Failsafe|Makeb}}</ref>

If Grell is with the Jedi Consular while dropping an army of Regulator droids over a [[light bridge]] that they would switch off between the [[Aboro Mesa|Aboro]] and [[Brakan Mesa]]s, then she would say that the light bridge was dazzling, questioning how anyone could walk over it every day. In the Jedi Master's company while destroying the Regulators' weapons on [[the Fingers]] mesa, Grell would muse that their actions should not only keep the engineers of [[the Ark]] safe but also annoy the Regulators.<ref name="Hitting the Hutts">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Hitting the Hutts|Makeb}}</ref> The Ark was a massive starship commissioned by [[Toborro]] the Hutt as his contingency plan to flee Makeb, and Grell was initially confused by the sight of what seemed to be just another building before being awed by the realization that it would be a flying ship.<ref name="The Ark">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|The Ark|Makeb}}</ref> Earlier, at the smaller starship ''[[Storm Carrier]]'', Grell warned her Master about their attackers and said that she was ready to bring the Regulators to justice.<ref name="Hitting the Hutts" />

Among the Regulators' crimes was the destruction of the city of [[Tarlam]]'s [[Cultural Archives]]. Gathered there with her Master, Grell would suppose that it showed a good lesson in what civilization would be reduced to if anarchy went unchecked. They battled Toborro's monstrous [[isotope-5 droid]]s&mdash;which stank, according to Grell, who was also horrified by their size&mdash;and shielded Tarlam's landing pads, which Grell would confirm should keep out the Hutts and their reinforcements.<ref name="Old Feuds">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Old Feuds|Makeb}}</ref> Grell, if joining the Jedi Consular at the [[Sanctuary research complex]], would comment that there surely must be a proverb about their enemies having so many weapons yet still failing to stop them. When releasing the wild animals held there as a distraction for Toborro's forces, Grell would say it was a shame to release them only for them to be shot at, though she would add that perhaps it would help save the entire planet.<ref name="Consulting the Expert" />

Later, if Grell is accompanying the Jedi Consular to stabilize Makeb's planet core at the first Hutt Cartel drilling platform they arrive at, she would exclaim that they are high in the sky, adding that it was a shame because she did really want to see what the heart of a planet looked like.<ref name="Planetary Surgery">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Planetary Surgery|Makeb}}</ref> While infiltrating [[Toborro's Palace]], Grell would characterize that the Hutt was holding Makeb "by the throat" and asked what inscrutable motive he could have for doing so, concluding that Toborro was indeed insane. Despite the beauty of Toborro's throne room, she could only feel madness and rage within. After Toborro's defeat, Grell would remark to the Jedi Consular that she had expected the Hutt's [[isotope-5 fuel rod]] to be larger and expressed her hope that enough fuel rods would be left to power the Ark.<ref name="Taking on Toborro">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Taking on Toborro|Makeb}}</ref>

===Jedi Under Siege update===
After Grell returned in the "Jedi Under Siege" update,<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> she became a romance option for all Jedi Consulars regardless of gender. Nadia can be invited to join the [[Eternal Alliance]] if the Outlander is a Consular.<ref name="Nadia Odessen" />
